summary: This note is a short biographical entry on actress Dakota Johnson. It describes how her lead role as Anastasia Steele in the 2015 romantic drama Fifty Shades of Grey brought her international fame, along with a People's Choice Award and a BAFTA Rising Star Award nomination. It also lists her other 2015 films and her later film work in the franchise and in romantic comedy.
one_line: Dakota Johnson is an actress known for playing Anastasia Steele in the Fifty Shades film series.
key_facts: Dakota Johnson received international recognition in 2015 after landing the lead role of Anastasia Steele in the romantic drama Fifty Shades of Grey.
Fifty Shades of Grey catapulted Dakota Johnson to fame.
Dakota Johnson won the People's Choice Award for Favorite Dramatic Movie Actress for Fifty Shades of Grey.
Dakota Johnson received a BAFTA Rising Star Award nomination.
In 2015, Dakota Johnson took part in the films Black Mass and A Bigger Splash.
Dakota Johnson starred in the romantic comedy How to Be Single, released in 2016.
Dakota Johnson reprised her role as Anastasia Steele in Fifty Shades Darker, released in 2017.
Dakota Johnson reprised her role as Anastasia Steele in Fifty Shades Freed, released in 2018.
